target: aggregate half-response-loss probability over natural completion phases
uncertainty: seed-bank bootstrap; factors and phases are dependent

protocol.primary: half-response loss over two successive half-completion phases
protocol.secondary: population factor corrections and exact missing-factor loss floor
protocol.optimizer: full objective GD, M_w=M_a=m; no frozen parameters or gates
protocol.prediction: unchanged analytic common-completion reserve; no fitted parameters
protocol.phase_endpoint: first ordinary step crossing half remaining head correction
